super_nodes.label: Diverse ML materials methods and datasets
super_nodes.gloss: A large, heterogeneous mix of cited works, methods, and datasets spanning ML interatomic potentials, databases, and materials informatics tools.

super_nodes.label: Equivariant neural network architecture components
super_nodes.gloss: Components, techniques, and methods for building E(3)/SE(3)-equivariant graph neural networks, including tensor products, virtual nodes, and equivariant layers.

super_nodes.label: Li-ion battery electrolyte phase behavior
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks, claims, and methods on phase transitions, diffusion, and stability in lithium-ion battery electrolyte materials like LiCoO2 and LGPS.

super_nodes.label: Materials informatics tasks and challenges
super_nodes.gloss: A broad, heterogeneous set of tasks, problems, and open challenges in high-throughput materials screening, property prediction, and materials informatics.

super_nodes.label: ML training and evaluation techniques
super_nodes.gloss: Diverse machine-learning techniques, methods, and engineering problems around training, optimization, evaluation, and workflow automation for materials ML models.

super_nodes.label: Computational scaling and efficiency of DFT
super_nodes.gloss: Techniques and problems addressing computational cost, scalability, and GPU parallelization for DFT and machine-learned interatomic potential calculations.

super_nodes.label: ML phonon and vibrational spectra prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks and methods for predicting phonon spectra, IR/Raman activity, and vibrational properties of materials using machine learning models like Phonax and JARVIS.

super_nodes.label: Machine-learned interatomic potentials and MD
super_nodes.gloss: Large, diverse cluster of claims, tasks, and methods on developing and evaluating machine-learned interatomic potentials for molecular dynamics simulations.

super_nodes.label: Radial basis and equivariant model techniques
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly technical components and training techniques, including radial basis/spherical harmonic expansions and learning-rate schedules, for equivariant ML potential models.

super_nodes.label: MD-17 molecular dynamics benchmark datasets
super_nodes.gloss: Dataset cluster dominated by MD-17 and CCSD(T) benchmark molecules (aspirin, benzene, ethanol, toluene, naphthalene) used to test interatomic potentials.

super_nodes.label: Monte Carlo sampling and fracture prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Mixed cluster combining Monte Carlo sampling techniques with ML-based fracture-pattern and hardness prediction methods; the connection between the two is unclear from the listing.

super_nodes.label: DeepH-family DFT Hamiltonian prediction models
super_nodes.gloss: Claims and datasets on DeepH, DeepH-E3, xDeepH, and HamGNN models predicting DFT Hamiltonians for twisted bilayer and magnetic 2D materials.

super_nodes.label: DFT+U methods and ML potential datasets
super_nodes.gloss: Diverse mix of DFT+U/Hubbard-correction methods, structure-search tools, and datasets of specific compounds used across machine-learned potential studies.

super_nodes.label: Named GNN interatomic potential architectures
super_nodes.gloss: A list of specific named neural network architectures (GemNet, DimeNet, MEGNet, PhysNet, SevenNet, etc.) for interatomic potentials and property prediction.

super_nodes.label: Equivariant geometric deep learning components
super_nodes.gloss: Components and methods for equivariant/geometric deep learning on 3D structures, including tensor-field networks, spherical CNNs, and continuous-filter convolutions.

super_nodes.label: Phase transition and phase-field modeling
super_nodes.gloss: Methods and tasks for modeling phase transitions and phase diagrams, including phase-field equations, nucleation theory, and Monte Carlo voltage-composition predictions.

super_nodes.label: Equivariant graph neural networks for materials
super_nodes.gloss: Methods and components for equivariant graph neural networks (e.g. EquiformerV2, harmonic networks) applied to materials and molecular property prediction.

super_nodes.label: Melting temperature and thermal property prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks, datasets, and methods for predicting melting temperature, thermal expansion, and related thermal/mechanical properties, often via melt-quench MD simulation.

super_nodes.label: Named ML tools and elemental datasets
super_nodes.gloss: Mixed collection of named software tools and methods (SISSO, Allegro, TorchANI, Magpie) alongside simple elemental datasets (Si, Al, Li, Diamond).

super_nodes.label: Classical ML regression and feature importance
super_nodes.gloss: Classical machine-learning techniques such as regression, clustering, and SHAP-based feature-importance analysis applied to materials property prediction.

super_nodes.label: Materials discovery and property prediction tasks
super_nodes.gloss: Large, diverse set of tasks, claims, and open problems on ML-driven materials discovery, high-throughput screening, and property prediction benchmarking.

super_nodes.label: GPU performance and parallel scaling
super_nodes.gloss: Problems, metrics, and techniques around GPU acceleration, parallel scaling, and numerical precision trade-offs for training and running ML potentials.

super_nodes.label: Optimization algorithms for design and hyperparameters
super_nodes.gloss: Optimization techniques (grid search, Bayesian optimization, evolutionary algorithms, gradient descent) used for hyperparameter tuning and materials design search.

super_nodes.label: Named author citations and DFT methods
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly a list of cited author names alongside DFT numerical methods (PAW, Ewald summation, tetrahedron method); no single clear topic unifies the sample.

super_nodes.label: JARVIS toolkit components and workflows
super_nodes.gloss: Components, apps, and workflows of the JARVIS materials-informatics toolkit, including its DFT, force-field, and ML sub-platforms.

super_nodes.label: Universal machine-learned interatomic potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Claims, methods, and problems about training universal machine-learned interatomic potentials and their element coverage, extrapolation, and training data limits.

super_nodes.label: Loss functions and optimizer scheduling
super_nodes.gloss: Training techniques for ML potentials: loss-function design (MSE, Huber, cross-entropy) and optimizer/learning-rate scheduling choices such as Adam and exponential decay.

super_nodes.label: Message-passing network components and virtual nodes
super_nodes.gloss: Architectural components of message-passing neural networks, with emphasis on virtual-node augmentation and directed message channels for property prediction.

super_nodes.label: DFT computational cost and scaling problems
super_nodes.gloss: Problems and methods addressing the computational scaling, accuracy, and SCF-convergence challenges of DFT, including finite-element and high-throughput DFT approaches.

super_nodes.label: Magnetic moment and charge-aware ML potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Claims and tasks on ML potentials (CHGNet, M3GNet, SevenNet) that model magnetic moments and charge degrees of freedom, plus related magneto-optical property prediction.

super_nodes.label: Convex hull stability and neighbor aggregation
super_nodes.gloss: Techniques for predicting convex-hull (thermodynamic stability) distance and for aggregating/padding neighbor lists in graph neural network potentials.

super_nodes.label: MD-17 molecular dynamics benchmark datasets
super_nodes.gloss: Dataset cluster dominated by MD-17 and CCSD(T) benchmark molecules (aspirin, benzene, ethanol, toluene, naphthalene) used to test interatomic potentials.

super_nodes.label: Deep Potential molecular dynamics methods
super_nodes.gloss: Claims, methods, and problems around Deep Potential (DeePMD) and SchNet-style neural network potentials for molecular dynamics of small molecules and water.

super_nodes.label: Cross-validation and test-set construction techniques
super_nodes.gloss: Techniques for building test sets and cross-validation schemes (k-fold, leave-one-cluster-out, out-of-distribution splits) to evaluate materials ML models.

super_nodes.label: OC20/OC22 benchmark datasets and tasks
super_nodes.gloss: Datasets and tasks centered on the OC20 and OC22 benchmark suites (S2EF, IS2RE) plus related evaluation metrics like ROC-AUC and MAE.

super_nodes.label: Radial basis functions and ACE descriptors
super_nodes.gloss: Technical components for radial-basis and cutoff-function descriptors, including Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) and its magnetic/spin-orbit extensions.

super_nodes.label: Monte Carlo and free-energy sampling methods
super_nodes.gloss: Monte Carlo and enhanced sampling techniques (Metropolis, umbrella sampling, Billiard Walk) for exploring high-dimensional free-energy and configuration spaces.

super_nodes.label: Elastic modulus and stress prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks and techniques for predicting stress fields and elastic moduli (bulk, shear, Young's) from ML potentials, often via automatic differentiation.

super_nodes.label: Workflow automation and uncertainty quantification problems
super_nodes.gloss: Mixed set of software/workflow-automation components (error handling, orchestration) and open problems like uncertainty quantification and out-of-domain extrapolation.

super_nodes.label: Activation functions for equivariant networks
super_nodes.gloss: Activation-function techniques (gate, S2, SiLU, Swish) used in equivariant neural networks, including the training-instability tradeoffs between them.

super_nodes.label: Atomistic simulation tools and scale bridging
super_nodes.gloss: Atomistic simulation software (ASE, atomate) and methods, together with problems bridging atomistic and continuum scales, including sp2/sp3 carbon characterization.

super_nodes.label: Charge equilibration and electrostatic energy models
super_nodes.gloss: Methods and problems around charge equilibration, long-range electrostatics, and oxidation-state constraints in differentiable ML energy models.

super_nodes.label: Phonon and band-gap prediction methods
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks and methods for predicting phonon dispersion, IR/Raman activity, and electronic band gaps using models like Phonax trained on DFPT data.

super_nodes.label: Li-ion diffusion in solid electrolytes
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks and claims on simulating and screening lithium-ion diffusion and stability in solid electrolyte materials such as LGPS, LLZO, and LiCoO2.

super_nodes.label: Normalization and scaling techniques for GNN-IPs
super_nodes.gloss: Normalization, regularization, and parallel-scaling techniques (layer norm, L2, spatial decomposition) for training graph neural network interatomic potentials.

super_nodes.label: DeepH-family DFT Hamiltonian prediction models
super_nodes.gloss: Claims and datasets on DeepH, DeepH-E3, xDeepH, and HamGNN models predicting DFT Hamiltonians for twisted bilayer and magnetic 2D materials.

super_nodes.label: Electronic minimizer algorithms and DOS filtering
super_nodes.gloss: Small cluster on electronic-structure minimization algorithms (RMM-DIIS, DBS) and density-of-states filtering/energy-window techniques.

super_nodes.label: Matbench and Automatminer benchmarking tools
super_nodes.gloss: Components and tasks of the Matminer/Automatminer/Matbench ecosystem for automated featurization and benchmarking materials ML pipelines.

super_nodes.label: Energy-conserving force prediction accuracy
super_nodes.gloss: Claims and problems on predicting atomic forces as energy gradients, force-field accuracy, and the role of force data in training efficiency (e.g. SchNet, MACE).

super_nodes.label: Symmetry-based structural descriptors and matching
super_nodes.gloss: Symmetry-adapted descriptor techniques (symmetry functions, invariant polynomials) and structure-matching methods used for interstitial-site and polymorph discrimination.

super_nodes.label: GNN models for materials property prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Claims about GNN models (CGCNN, MEGNet, M3GNet, PNA) for property and free-energy prediction, including IDNN-based free-energy integration methods.

super_nodes.label: Active learning and transfer learning workflows
super_nodes.gloss: Techniques for active-learning data acquisition, transfer learning, and training-set cleaning/curation used to build ML potential training workflows.

super_nodes.label: Formation energy prediction and evaluation metrics
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks and error metrics (MAE, RMSE) for predicting formation, ground-state, and activation energies in ML interatomic potential models.

super_nodes.label: Spherical harmonics and composition encoding
super_nodes.gloss: Feature-encoding techniques using spherical harmonics and composition/atom-type encodings (one-hot, two-hot, composition-weighted) for equivariant network inputs.

super_nodes.label: ML-accelerated crystal structure relaxation
super_nodes.gloss: Methods and tasks for using ML potentials (denoising, pre-relaxation) to accelerate crystal structure relaxation compared to direct DFT relaxation.

super_nodes.label: DFT accuracy validation and amorphous structures
super_nodes.gloss: Mixed cluster of claims validating DFT/ML accuracy (band gaps, formation energies, elastic constants) together with tasks generating amorphous carbon and silicon structures.

super_nodes.label: ConvLSTM fracture and hardness prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks and claims on using a ConvLSTM model to predict crack patterns, fracture toughness, and Vicker's hardness from molecular dynamics data.

super_nodes.label: Two- and three-body atomic descriptors
super_nodes.gloss: Components for two-body and three-body atomic descriptors (DeepPot-SE, SOAP) used as inputs to machine-learned interatomic potentials.

super_nodes.label: Fitting networks and curve-fitting techniques
super_nodes.gloss: Small cluster on fitting-network output modules (GAP, DeePMD-style) and curve-fitting techniques like Arrhenius and polynomial fits for potential energy properties.

super_nodes.label: Deep-learning DFT Hamiltonian model architecture
super_nodes.gloss: Architectural components (Wigner-Eckart layer, LCMP) and problems for deep neural networks that predict the DFT Hamiltonian matrix with rotational equivariance.

super_nodes.label: Elemental and composition embedding techniques
super_nodes.gloss: Component and technique cluster on atom-type and elemental embeddings used to represent composition and species information in ML models.

super_nodes.label: Surface slab generation and surface energy
super_nodes.gloss: Tasks and problems on generating surface slabs/nanoparticles and modeling potential energy surfaces and surface energies, including amorphous materials.
